summary: The diff implements AsyncDisposableStack.prototype.use in order: it reads the argument, then RequireInternalSlot via require_async_disposable_stack with ?, throws a ReferenceError when the stack is disposed, calls add_disposable_resource(..., DisposeKind::Async, None) with ?, and returns the value. Each spec step is kept as a comment above its code, the not-implemented stub is removed, and no other files change. The helpers it calls come from the existing support module and are not part of this diff, so I did not check their internals. Nothing in the diff special-cases inputs, returns made-up values, or swallows errors.
